page_title: FUL 0-2 MCI | Fulham v Manchester City 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
90+5' Sander Berge (Fulham) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Ederson anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
90+4' Ederson (Manchester City) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90+3' Ederson (Manchester City) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+2' A nice individual effort by Alex Iwobi (Fulham) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Surely that's handball by one of the Manchester City players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
89' Fulham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
85' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Sasa Lukic will be replaced by Sander Berge (Fulham).
85' Substitution. Ilkay Gundogan is replaced by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City).
85' Erling Haaland will be replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Manchester City).
83' A pass by Savinho (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
82' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Omar Marmoush and he is replaced by Phil Foden (Manchester City).
80' The current number of shots on goal is 2:5.
76' What a big chance! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Savinho (Manchester City) is coming onto the pitch as Jeremy Doku cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Here is a change. Adama Traore is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
74' The substitution is prepared. Joshua King (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tom Cairney.
72' 0 - 2 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Bernd Leno to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
72' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
71' Referee Andy Madley sees the trip by Sasa Lukic (Fulham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to Manchester City!
67' Superb first touch by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) as he latched on to a lofted pass to send the ball high over the bar from long range.
64' The game is interrupted as Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is flagged offside.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Wilson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alex Iwobi (Fulham).
61' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Andreas Pereira is replaced by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).
60' Manchester City are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
56' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
54' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
50' Harry Wilson (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' A player from Manchester City commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
49' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) steps up to send the ball in.
46' Referee Andy Madley blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
45+1' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.

44' Kenny Tete (Fulham) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Ederson anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.

42' Nico (Manchester City) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it low towards the middle of the target, but Bernd Leno pulled off a nice save and to stop the attempt.
41' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
40' Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
36' Tom Cairney (Fulham) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
36' Tom Cairney (Fulham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
35' Andy Madley blows his whistle and it's Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester City comes to nothing.
32' Ederson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Adama Traore (Fulham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
29' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
29' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
27' Adama Traore (Fulham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
27' Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Ederson. What a save!
21' 0 - 1 GOAL! Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) gets to the rebound inside the box and fires in a stunning overhead kick. Phenomenal finish! 0:1.
21' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
17' A lofted cross from Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
16' Kenny Tete (Fulham) makes a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Manchester City in a dangerous position.
14' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but Bernd Leno comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
8' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
7' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) trips an opposition player and Andy Madley signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester City.
4' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has started.
